title: Turkey Meatball Tray with Pears
tagline: Thanksgiving dinner, shrunk to meatballs and sent to one tray.

ingredients.item: firm pears, cored and cut into wedges

ingredients.qty: 1 tsp salt plus a few grinds

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Tip the sprouts, pear wedges and chestnuts onto a large tray with 2 tbsp olive oil, a pinch of salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the turkey mince, breadcrumbs, sage, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper with your hands. Roll into 16 even balls.
Push the vegetables to the edges of the tray. Add the meatballs, drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp oil, and roast for 15 minutes, until golden.
Stir the cider with the remaining 1 tbsp mustard. Pour it over the tray and roast for 10 minutes more, until the meatballs are cooked through with no pink inside.
Rest for 5 minutes, then spoon the sticky tray juices over everything and serve straight from the tray.
image_prompt: A large rustic roasting tray of golden-brown sage turkey meatballs nestled among caramelised halved Brussels sprouts, glossy pear wedges and whole roasted chestnuts, with sticky cider and mustard juices pooling at the bottom and a few fresh sage leaves scattered on top.
alt_text: A roasting tray of golden turkey meatballs with roasted Brussels sprouts, pear wedges and chestnuts in glossy cider juices.
caption_hook:
All the bits you actually want from a Thanksgiving plate, minus the six-hour sulk in the kitchen. Stuffing flavours, rolled into meatballs.
